books.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
books.author: J. K. Rowling
books.summary: An invitation arrives by owl, a hidden platform opens, and a boy discovers the world has been keeping a large secret. The first year at Hogwarts.
books.description: Harry Potter has spent eleven years in a cupboard under the stairs. Then letters begin arriving, a giant knocks down the door, and he steps onto a train bound for a school of magic. The first volume is a boarding-school story with moving staircases, new friends, and a mystery waiting behind a forbidden door. It is the place to begin.
books.curatorNote: The door opens here. Start with this one.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
books.author: J. K. Rowling
books.summary: A second year, a voice in the walls, and a school turning slowly to stone. Harry returns to Hogwarts to find the past has not finished speaking.
books.description: Summer at the Dursleys ends with a rescue, a flying car, and a warning that does not stop Harry from returning to Hogwarts. But something is moving through the corridors, students are being found petrified, and a forgotten chamber is being talked about again. The second volume tightens the mystery and widens the history.
books.curatorNote: A mystery with a long memory.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
books.author: J. K. Rowling
books.summary: A prison escape, a map that shows every footstep, and a godfather Harry never knew he had. The third year changes what Harry thinks he knows about his parents.
books.description: A dangerous prisoner has escaped from Azkaban, and the castle is ringed by dementors. Harry's third year brings a new Defence teacher, a Marauder's Map, and a series of near misses that keep pointing toward a man from his parents' past. The story turns from mystery toward family — and leaves several assumptions overturned.
books.curatorNote: The year the past starts answering back.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
books.author: J. K. Rowling
books.summary: Three schools, one tournament, and a year of dangerous spectacle. Harry is entered in a contest he never meant to join.
books.description: Hogwarts hosts the Triwizard Tournament, and students from two other schools arrive for a year of competition. When Harry's name comes out of the Goblet, the rules say he must compete. The fourth volume is the series at its most expansive: a crowded school year, a widening world, and a final task that changes the story's direction altogether.
books.curatorNote: The series stretches its legs — and raises the stakes.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
books.author: J. K. Rowling
books.summary: A divided school, a secret army, and a prophecy Harry was never meant to hear. The longest year, and the heaviest.
books.description: The wizarding world is arguing about what happened at the end of the tournament, and Hogwarts is no calmer. With a new Defence teacher appointed from outside and a Ministry determined to control the story, Harry teaches a group of students to defend themselves. The fifth volume is the largest and most political, carrying the series through a year of grief, resistance, and open conflict.
books.curatorNote: The longest book, and the loudest argument.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
books.author: J. K. Rowling
books.summary: A memory borrowed, a promise made, and a year spent looking at the past. The sixth volume sets the pieces for the end.
books.description: Harry returns for his sixth year with the war no longer in the distance. Dumbledore gives him a task of his own: to recover a memory and understand the history that made the present dangerous. Meanwhile, the castle is full of ordinary school life, shifting friendships, and one terrible certainty. This is the quietest book before the storm, and perhaps the most consequential.
books.curatorNote: Quiet on the surface; everything underneath is moving.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
books.author: J. K. Rowling
books.summary: No school, no map, and no safe place left to hide. The last volume follows the hunt to its end.
books.description: Harry, Ron, and Hermione leave Hogwarts behind to finish what Dumbledore began. Their search takes them across a country that is no longer friendly, with the Ministry changed and the old protections falling away. The final volume is a road story, a war story, and a reckoning with everything the series has been building toward. Read the others first.
books.curatorNote: The last turn of the page. No shortcuts.
